I'm confirming the successful implementation of CSV reading, CRUD operations, the Prontuário view, dynamic handling of numerous columns, basic filters, a dashboard, and the dictionary feature. I am also planning on formatting the code to ensure strict XML structure, correct imports, and TypeScript syntax, particularly focusing on modularity.

export const getGeoByCode = (code: string): GeoLocation | undefined => {
  return DF_GEO_DB.find(geo => geo.id_bairro === code);
};

export const suggestGeoByAddress = (address: string, district: string): GeoLocation | undefined => {
  const searchTerms = (address + ' ' + district).toLowerCase();
  
  // Scoring system to find best match in descriptions
  let bestMatch: GeoLocation | undefined;
  let maxScore = 0;

  for (const geo of DF_GEO_DB) {
    if (geo.descricao === 'Null') continue;
    
    const keywords = geo.descricao.toLowerCase().split(/[.,:;\s]+/).filter(k => k.length > 3);
    let score = 0;
    
    // Check main Bairro name
    if (searchTerms.includes(geo.bairro.toLowerCase())) score += 10;

    // Check keywords in description
    for (const word of keywords) {
      if (searchTerms.includes(word)) score += 1;
    }

    if (score > maxScore && score > 2) { // Threshold
      maxScore = score;
      bestMatch = geo;
    }
  }

  return bestMatch;
};
